title: Orphan Sponsorship - One Year of Food and Education
description: Financing living expenses and education costs for an orphaned child in Syria. Through direct communication with our local partners, we can ensure maximum transparency and make sure the money reaches the right places.

title: Gift a Monthly Salary to a Family in Need
description: Salaries in Syria are very low despite recent increases since December 2024. However, goods and basic necessities are not. With a sum <100 €, you can enormously support a family in need for one month.

title: Drinking Water Well for Village
description: Procurement and installation of a drinking water well for a small village, especially important for extreme heat due to climate change and lack of drinking facilities in Syria.

title: El-Asafir Community Infrastructure
description: 250 kW solar system for a rural school, agricultural hub and residential buildings. Over 10,000 people, 500 students and 50 agricultural operations receive stable electricity for education and production.

title: Douma National Hospital Renovation
description: Restoration of part of the capacity of a hospital that serves over 1 million patients annually. The hospital, documented with drone footage after 12.2024, was completely bombed by the old regime. Our partner NGO in Douma has established a multi-specialty clinic after the destruction and wants to continue building and rehabilitate it into a hospital.

title: Renovation of 5 Schools in Douma
description: Renovation of schools to safe, high-quality standards. 3,000+ students receive improved educational environments with modern classrooms, sanitary facilities and barrier-free access.
